title: Source code and running behavior are distinct
proposition: Source code is a representation consumed by language tooling, while observable running behavior emerges through execution in an engine and host environment.
scope: JavaScript is the concrete example; other language implementations may use different translation and runtime paths.
exceptions: The claim does not require every language to use a separate interpreter, compiler, or host process.
score_rationale: Current official documentation directly supports the bounded JavaScript example; wording explicitly prevents universalizing one implementation pipeline.
